Parse path: initialize the marker strings for the AND group, the delimiter set and the NOT group; seed a second marker from dword_5D30C0 and zero the three group counters and the per-group array index.
Copy the filter string into a 256-byte local buffer and clear the three 50-entry token arrays with memset before tokenizing.
Tokenize the copied string with sub_5897CA using the delimiter set, re-invoking sub_5897CA with a null buffer until no further tokens are produced.

Classify each token with sub_588410 against the AND literal, then the marker held in dword_5D30C0, then the NOT literal; set the group selector v14 to 0 (default), 1 (AND group) or 2 (NOT group) accordingly.
Store each accepted token's index into the 50-entry array chosen by the group selector, capped at 49 entries per group.

VehicleFilteringSelection(this, default-group array, count) builds the base list; VehicleGridSelection(this, AND-group array, count) intersects the explicit AND matches; LinkedListSearchRemoval(this, NOT-group array, count) removes NOT matches and returns the exclusion count.
Finalize: reset iterator this+0x10 to head this+0x8 and clear the auxiliary field this+0x18 to 0.
Return the NOT-group exclusion count from LinkedListSearchRemoval (zero on the fallback path).
